---
name: Specification change proposal
about: Propose a change to the JOS specification, the JSON Schema, or the conformance requirements
title: "[proposal] "
labels: proposal
---

## Summary

One paragraph: what changes and why.

## Change class

Which class under GOVERNANCE.md "Change classes" (editorial / compatible addition / breaking)?

## Motivation

What cannot be expressed or validated today? Link the documents or implementations affected.

## Specification text

The exact wording or schema fragment to add, change, or remove.

## Compatibility

What happens to existing `.jos` documents and to conforming runtimes? Migration notes if breaking.

## Examples

At least one `.jos` example that validates against the proposed schema.
